AccessConfig.description:
The Cloudflare Access listener: a second, loopback-only plain-HTTP port a
Cloudflare Tunnel points at, which admits only requests carrying a valid
Access JWT. Every field empty means the listener is off; stating any of them
turns it on and every rule in [`check`] applies.

allowed_emails.description:
Email addresses an Access user token may carry.
Env: `MOBUX_ACCESS_ALLOWED_EMAILS` (comma separated).
Flag: `--access-allowed-email`.

aud.description:
The Access application AUD tag tokens must carry.
Env: `MOBUX_ACCESS_AUD`. Flag: `--access-aud`.

hostname.description:
Public hostname the tunnel serves mobux on, a bare hostname.
Env: `MOBUX_ACCESS_HOSTNAME`. Flag: `--access-hostname`.

port.description:
Loopback port the tunnel connects to. Must differ from `server.port`.
`0` turns the listener off. Env: `MOBUX_ACCESS_PORT`. Flag: `--access-port`.

service_tokens.description:
Client ids of the Access service tokens admitted without a user.
Env: `MOBUX_ACCESS_SERVICE_TOKENS` (comma separated).
Flag: `--access-service-token`.

team_domain.description:
The Cloudflare Access team domain: a bare hostname such as
`example.cloudflareaccess.com`, which means https, or an `https://`
origin. `http://` is accepted only for `127.0.0.1` and `localhost`.
No path or query. Env: `MOBUX_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN`.
Flag: `--access-team-domain`.

domain.description:
Public `host` or `host:port` the Android app is pinned to. Empty means
unset. Env: `MOBUX_DOMAIN`.

service_name.description: systemd unit the self-updater restarts. Env: `MOBUX_SERVICE_NAME`.

AuthConfig.description: The credentials that unlock the web UI.

pass.description:
Password. Empty means unset; `pin` is the usual way to set it.
Env: `MOBUX_AUTH_PASS`.

pin.description:
Numeric PIN, 4-64 characters. Empty means unset. Env: `MOBUX_PIN`.
Flag: `--pin`.

user.description: Username. Empty means unset. Env: `MOBUX_AUTH_USER`. Flag: `--user`.

FilesConfig.description:
Host directories served behind the same auth as the UI, at
`/files/<name>/`.

listing.description:
List a directory that has no `index.html`. Off answers 404 instead.
Env: `MOBUX_FILES_LISTING`.

roots.description:
Directories to serve, keyed by the `<name>` in `/files/<name>/`. A name
is letters, digits, `-` and `_`; a path is absolute. Empty serves
nothing. Env: `MOBUX_FILES` (`name=path` pairs, comma separated).

McpConfig.description:
The MCP server agents on the host reach at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp`.
It binds loopback only and takes no credentials.

port.description:
Loopback port the MCP server listens on. `0` turns it off.
Env: `MOBUX_MCP_PORT`. Flag: `--mcp-port`.

data_dir.description:
Directory for the database and other state. Empty means the platform
data directory. Env: `MOBUX_DATA_DIR`.

ProxyConfig.description:
Local ports reverse-proxied behind the same auth as the UI, at
`/proxy/<name>/`.

targets.description:
Loopback ports to proxy, keyed by the `<name>` in `/proxy/<name>/`. A
name is letters, digits, `-` and `_`; the port is on 127.0.0.1. Empty
proxies nothing. Env: `MOBUX_PROXY` (`name=port` pairs, comma
separated).

vapid_contact.description: VAPID contact, a `mailto:` or `https:` URL. Env: `MOBUX_VAPID_CONTACT`.

base_path.description:
Path prefix a reverse proxy publishes mobux under, e.g. `/mobux`. Empty
means the site root. The proxy strips the prefix before mobux sees the
request, so routing never reads this — it exists so the session cookie
carries the `Path` the browser is actually on.
Env: `MOBUX_BASE_PATH`. Flag: `--base-path`.

behind_tls_proxy.description:
Trust a reverse proxy to terminate TLS. The bind stays plain HTTP, but
the session cookie keeps its `Secure` flag because the browser reaches
mobux over HTTPS. Env: `MOBUX_BEHIND_TLS_PROXY`. Flag:
`--behind-tls-proxy`.

port.description: TCP port to listen on. Env: `MOBUX_PORT`. Flag: `--port`.

shell.description:
Shell to launch inside tmux. Empty means `$SHELL`.
Env: `MOBUX_SESSION_SHELL`.

SpeechConfig_SttKind.description: A speech provider block: the kind in use and the settings per kind.

providers.description:
Settings per provider kind. A kind left out, or a field left empty,
takes that kind's defaults.

SpeechConfig_TtsKind.description: A speech provider block: the kind in use and the settings per kind.

providers.description:
Settings per provider kind. A kind left out, or a field left empty,
takes that kind's defaults.

SttKind.description: Where dictation from the microphone button is transcribed.

api_key.description: API key sent to the provider. Never returned by the settings API.

model.description: Model id sent to the provider.

port.description: Port, as text; empty means the scheme's default.

TlsConfig.description: HTTPS: the built-in CA, a supplied key pair, or ACME.

acme_domains.description:
Domains to obtain an ACME certificate for. A non-empty list switches
TLS into ACME mode. Env: `MOBUX_ACME_DOMAINS` (comma separated).

acme_email.description:
Account contact for the ACME directory. Required in ACME mode.
Env: `MOBUX_ACME_EMAIL`.

acme_http_port.description: Port the HTTP-01 challenge responder binds. Env: `MOBUX_ACME_HTTP_PORT`.

cert_file.description:
Path to a certificate PEM. Set both this and `key_file` to skip
certificate generation. Env: `MOBUX_CERT_FILE`.

enabled.description:
Serve HTTPS. Off by default; plain HTTP is the safe assumption behind a
proxy and the only one that works without a trusted certificate.
Env: `MOBUX_TLS`.

hosts.description:
Extra hostnames to add to the generated certificate.
Env: `MOBUX_TLS_HOSTS` (comma separated).

key_file.description: Path to the private key PEM matching `cert_file`. Env: `MOBUX_KEY_FILE`.

TtsKind.description: The voice Listen mode reads the terminal with.

oneOf.description: The Piper voice in the mobux process.

api_key.description: API key sent to the provider. Never returned by the settings API.

model.description: Model id sent to the provider.

port.description: Port, as text; empty means the scheme's default.

voice.description: Voice id or preset name sent to the provider.

check_url.description: Where the version list is fetched from. Env: `MOBUX_UPDATE_CHECK_URL`.

description:
Every setting mobux reads from a file. Absent state is a sentinel — an empty
string or an empty list — never a missing attribute, so a merged config is
always fully populated.

stt.description:
Speech-to-text: where dictation from the microphone button is
transcribed. File-only: no environment variable or flag sets it.

tts.description:
Text-to-speech: the voice Listen mode reads the terminal with.
File-only: no environment variable or flag sets it.
